content.short: The first 8-bit pixel art collection on Cardano.
content.description:
CardanoBits, a Cardano's NFT project, launched in a very early stage of this great ecosystem.

After a very crowded launch, finished in just minutes, using Gdocs and giving the Yoroi network a nice stress test... Lots of Cbits arrived at the people wallets, and now the only way to get one of them is through the "secondary market". Until smart contracts arrive, and we can have marketplaces to easily operate, we suggest to check the escrow service being made at the CNFT.io and CardanoNFT discords.

Only 10.000 CardanoBits were minted, using a time-locked policy. Each one is unique, and generated with a mix of art pieces and computer algorithms.
